songs.title: The Score (feat. Marv Won)
songs.verdict: Two Detroit rappers with big personalities trade verses over a beat from a Griselda-affiliated producer, a pairing that on paper should feel natural.
songs.body:
Bruiser Wolf is a Detroit underground rapper from Danny Brown's Bruiser Brigade circle. Conductor Williams is a producer known for work with Griselda and Drake.
The single features Detroit battle-rap veteran Marv Won and leads into their joint album The Dealer Wins (Station/Bruiser House), due Nov 11, 2026.
songs.scout_note: Lane: Detroit underground / drug-rap storytelling. Released 2026-11-06, confirmed on the Spotify track page and in Stereogum's Nov 6 post (https://stereogum.com/2516807/bruiser-wolf-conductor-williams-announce-new-album-the-dealer-wins-hear-the-score-feat-marv-won/music), which embeds the YouTube video. Label: Station/Bruiser House, independent. CHECK LISTENERS: Bruiser Wolf has a Wikipedia page and features with Danny Brown and Benny the Butcher, so likely over 100k monthly; qualifies on the no-major-label rule only.

songs.title: Masons Dispatch
songs.verdict: An archival Detroit loosie, described as groove-laden, from a session the duo had written off as lost.
songs.body:
Zelooperz is a Detroit rapper from the Bruiser Brigade orbit who works often with producer Black Noi$e.
The track comes from Pin Breakers, an album recorded at the Bruiser Brigade house in 2017-2019, lost on a discarded hard drive and recovered years later.
songs.scout_note: Lane: Detroit experimental / underground rap. Shared 2026-11-05 with Stereogum's same-day post (https://stereogum.com/2516633/zelooperz-black-noise-masons-dispatch-pin-breakers/music). Album Pin Breakers out 2026-11-13 (Apple: https://music.apple.com/is/album/pin-breakers/6817910167, '(P) 2026 Tan Cressida under exclusive license to The Harp'); Apple link left out of the song fields since it's the album. Tan Cressida is Earl Sweatshirt's imprint; distributor unconfirmed. CHECK LISTENERS: features with Earl, Alchemist, Injury Reserve, may be over 100k.

songs.title: FATAL DELUXE
songs.verdict: Brazilian dark and terror plugg that reportedly mixes chopped-and-screwed haze with industrial and power-noise grit, the kind of left-field rage-adjacent tape the underground pages share.
songs.body:
FAB GODAMN is an underground rapper from Guarulhos, Sao Paulo, Brazil, with a run of 2026 singles and the compilation GODAMN SELECT.
FATAL DELUXE is a 21-track project in the dark plugg / terror plugg lane, with videos for 'BOLO' (with MANU GODAMN) and 'CHAPADO'.
songs.scout_note: Lane: Brazilian dark plugg / terror plugg. Released 2026-10-20 per Spotify album page and Apple artist page. Found in the idontknowerik Substack weekly wrap-up Oct 19-25 (https://idontknowerik.substack.com/p/weekly-wrap-up-oct-19th-2026-oct). No label listed; looks small, listeners unchecked. Single-song alternative: 'BOLO' (Apple https://music.apple.com/us/song/bolo/6814698454, YouTube https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qPD00PRDB-w). Doubt: deluxe edition; couldn't tell which tracks are new.

songs.title: BINE
songs.verdict: A 16-track debut from an artist who has built up slowly through loose singles, now landing on Apple's UK Rap List year-end playlist.
songs.body:
Young Eman is an independent rapper with singles going back to 2023 (EAZI, 2DASIDE!, ion trust, money & violence).
BINE is his first full album, 16 tracks and about 43 minutes, licensed to September Recordings.
songs.scout_note: Lane: new-gen underground rap. Released 2026-10-30 per Apple and Spotify; Apple shows '(P) 2026 Young Eman under exclusive license to September Recordings Ltd' and features it on 'UK Rap List: Best of 2026'. Listed in HotNewHipHop's Oct 30 roundup (https://www.hotnewhiphop.com/1014859-hip-hop-albums-songs-october-30-2026). Official site per YouTube: binebinebine.com. Doubts: home base unclear (UK vs New England); listener count unchecked; no published description of the sound, so the verdict stays general.

songs.title: Rookie Of The Year
songs.verdict: A short title-track single that opened the rollout for his second 2026 album and has been picking up early views on YouTube.
songs.body:
RodSlime is an independent rapper releasing through the Run Things imprint, with the album Slime Beliefs and several singles out in 2026.
The single was the title track for his follow-up album Rookie Of The Year (15 tracks), released Nov 6, 2026.
songs.scout_note: Lane: street rap (guess; Apple only says Hip-Hop/Rap). Single released 2026-10-23 per Apple ('(P) 2026 Run Things') and YouTube Topic (Label Engine); ~66K views when checked. Album followed 2026-11-06 (https://music.apple.com/us/album/rookie-of-the-year/6824617644). Listed in HotNewHipHop's Oct 30 and Nov 6 roundups. Weakest rap pick: no press on his sound or hometown; track is ~1 minute. Listeners unchecked.

songs.title: internet niche fame
songs.verdict: A Toronto DJ's debut that runs hyperpop vocals through hard dance and trance, which puts it closer to rave than to the bedroom.
songs.body:
Zorza is a Toronto DJ and producer who plays clubs and festivals in Europe and North America and launched her own independent label, 4ever Music, this year.
Her 10-track debut mixes hyperpop, hard dance and trance around online personas, touring burnout and finding the point of music again.
songs.scout_note: Lane: hyperpop / hyperdance, same club-hyperpop space as Ninajirachi. Released 2026-10-30, confirmed on Bandcamp, Apple ('2026 4ever Music') and Spotify. EARMILK track-by-track Oct 30 (https://earmilk.com/2026/10/30/zorza-breaks-down-her-debut-album-internet-niche-fame-track-by-track/); EDM Identity covered it too. Singles: HAUNTED, MOTION SICK (FAULT premiere Sept), Last Ride, number 1 ft. Julia Cooper. Self-released. Listeners unchecked, likely well under 100k. Press pages link IG @zzzorza (not an official source, so left blank). Doubt: leans hard dance/trance more than glitchy hyperpop.

songs.title: Clustered Around My Opening!
songs.verdict: A maximalist one-off that reportedly runs vaporwave synth-funk into drum 'n' bass breaks and screamed vocals, for listeners who like their glitch-pop overloaded.
songs.body:
Fire-Toolz is the main project of Angel Marcloid, a Chicago-associated experimental producer and mastering engineer with releases on Hausu Mountain and Orange Milk, now on Warp.
This stand-alone single starts in '80s-style vaporwave synth-funk, then piles on breakbeats and screamo vocals until the mix overloads on purpose.
songs.scout_note: Lane: glitch / digital-hardcore-adjacent maximalism, crossposted between hyperpop and experimental circles. Released 2026-10-30 per Apple artist page; Stereogum covered it same day (https://stereogum.com/2516134/fire-toolz-cluster-around-my-opening/music) as a one-off. Warp is independent. Listeners unchecked, probably under 100k but may have grown since the Warp signing. Farthest of the hyperpop picks from pop. Apple only playable link verified.

songs.title: Sore Loser
songs.verdict: A tongue-in-cheek single that puts bright pop hooks over breakcore drums and heavy alt guitars, aiming for glitch-pop that sounds huge.
songs.body:
Hex Girlfriend are James Knott and Noah Yorke, a South London duo who started making music in their Goldsmiths halls; Knott self-produces.
'Sore Loser' is pitched as colourful and digitally sharp, mixing pop melodies with breakcore and heavy guitars, and comes with UK tour dates for March 2027.
songs.scout_note: Lane: breakcore-pop / glitch-pop. Released 2026-10-28 as a 2-track single per Deezer; Clash news post same day (https://www.clashmusic.com/news/hex-girlfriend-share-new-single-sore-loser-announce-uk-shows/), which embeds the YouTube video (converted from embed; video page not opened). Only ~121 Deezer fans, so very small on streaming, though press-heavy because Noah Yorke is Thom Yorke's son. LABEL CHECK: Soil To The Sun, described by Dork as a new Relentless Records imprint (Sony-affiliated); passes on listener count, not independence.

songs.title: Shed
songs.verdict: A San Antonio duo making shimmering, hook-forward dream pop that stays calm without going still.
songs.body:
Orca is the San Antonio dream-pop duo of Mylena Velasquez and Daniel Galloway (once called Space Cowboys); this EP follows Ladybird and Soren.
Shed goes for buoyant, soothing dream pop with stronger hooks than their earlier releases, produced and engineered by Hether.
songs.scout_note: Lane: alt/indie, dream pop. FADER 'The Opener' 2026-11-16 (https://www.thefader.com/2026/11/16/the-opener-orca-dreampop-shed) says the EP came out the Friday before (~2026-11-13, inferred). Numbers not found but very small; no label named. Spotify/Apple converted from FADER embeds. FADER links IG @orcaofficialtx (press link, so artist_ig blank).

songs.title: Hark
songs.verdict: Surreal, Lynchian goth-pop that reportedly mixes late-2000s indie-rock smoothness with crooner drama and distorted synth swells.
songs.body:
Clyde Crooks is an L.A.-born songwriter and producer who has produced for Nate Sib and Loukemann; his debut was 2025's let the red curtain down.
Hark is a goth-pop EP about grief, addiction and getting sober, closing with the crooner-style 'Coldest Day of the Year.'
songs.scout_note: Lane: alt/indie, goth/art pop. Released 2026-09-18 per Line of Best Fit (https://www.thelineofbestfit.com/news/clyde-crooks-readies-new-ep-hark-with-coldest-day-of-the-year-single), right at the 60-day edge. Label: The Nest Records (indie). FADER Opener 2026-09-28 (https://www.thefader.com/2026/09/28/the-opener-clyde-crooks-hark-ep) and Ones To Watch 2026-11-11. Numbers not found. Links converted from FADER embeds.

songs.title: Don't Worry Dynamite
songs.verdict: Bright, jangly New York garage-indie built on a catchy guitar line and recorded raw.
songs.body:
Star's Revenge is a New York band of Olive Faber (Sunflower Bean), Emily Green (Geese), Christian Billard (Turnip King) and Jonny Ceballos (The Paranoyds).
The single previews their second album, Star's Revenge II, due Nov 27, mostly cut live to tape for an unpolished jangle-pop sound.
songs.scout_note: Lane: alt/indie. Exact date unconfirmed; out by 2026-11-06 (Line of Best Fit New Music Discovery: https://thelineofbestfit.com/news/new-music-discovery-playlist-stars-revenge-scam-crate-maehem99-cosign-rainfield), FADER 'Songs You Need' 2026-11-11 (https://thefader.com/2026/11/11/songs-you-need-in-your-life-this-week-november-11-2026), ArtistRack 2026-11-09 (https://artistrack.com/?p=311448). No label named. Members play in bigger bands (Geese) but this band looks small. Spotify from ArtistRack embed, YouTube from FADER embed.

songs.title: Decimate
songs.verdict: Sultry, slow-burn R&B that's been described as tense, subterranean grooves and ambient swirl under a breathy-to-soaring vocal.
songs.body:
Maeta is an R&B singer known for 'Through The Night' (feat. Free Nationals) and the project When I Hear Your Name, back after about four years away, now independent and co-producing.
Decimate opens a more vulnerable era: polished R&B over a hypnotic percussive pulse.
songs.scout_note: Lane: R&B/alt-R&B. Date conflict, both inside window: Remixd New Music Friday Oct 30 (https://remixdmagazine.com/new-music-friday-week-of-october-30-2026/) says Oct 13; ArtistRack (https://artistrack.com/maeta-decimate-single/) had it out Sep 29. Via Human Re Sources (indie distribution). CHECK LISTENERS: past credits with SZA, Kehlani, KAYTRANADA and a sold-out LA show, may be over 100k; qualifies on no-major rule. Spotify from ArtistRack embed.

songs.title: Prime Life
songs.verdict: A short, smooth Houston R&B-rap blend that leans on the city's slow-riding tradition.
songs.body:
Ceazy is an independent rap and R&B artist from Houston.
Prime Life is a 2:22 track produced by KINGXMAGS that pairs a rap delivery with a smooth, slow-riding R&B feel.
songs.scout_note: Lane: R&B/rap crossover. Released 2026-10-16 per Remixd New Music Friday Oct 30, 'In Case You Missed It' (https://remixdmagazine.com/new-music-friday-week-of-october-30-2026/). Independent, very small; thin buzz (one press mention). Spotify from Remixd embed.

songs.title: Talk To Me
songs.verdict: An earnest R&B single about the anxiety of silence and emotional distance in a long relationship.
songs.body:
L!ka is Diana Kagan, a singer based in New York City; the song draws on a six-year relationship.
Talk To Me is about the fear of losing connection when things go quiet, produced, mixed and mastered by Altershade.
songs.scout_note: Lane: R&B, submission tier. Exact date not stated; EARMILK covered it as new 2026-11-16 (https://earmilk.com/2026/11/16/lka-captures-the-anxiety-of-love-and-silence-in-heartfelt-new-single-talk-to-me/), so likely early-to-mid Nov. Very small. Spotify links from EARMILK. EARMILK links IG @_lika_dk (press link, left blank).

songs.verdict: A guitar-free London collage record of live drums, bass, synths and samples that pulls from hip-hop, dub and club music into hypnotic, fuzzy trances.
songs.body:
RIP Magic is a London four-piece (Beth Boswell-Knight, Felix Bayley-Higgins, Marco Pini, Pedro Takahashi); James Murphy produced their earlier single '5words' for DFA.
1,2,3 is their debut album: beat-driven, trip-hop-leaning collage with odd samples and deliberately naive songwriting.
songs.scout_note: Lane: left-field electronic. Released 2026-10-30 per Bandcamp, Apple and Stereogum (https://stereogum.com/2512311/rip-magic-announce-debut-album-123-hear-stadium-drive/music). Label: section1 (Partisan-affiliated indie). Stereogum Band To Watch 2026-11-02 and its 40 Best New Artists of 2026 (#27), FADER Opener, Clash, Line of Best Fit. CHECK LISTENERS: heavy hype, could be near 100k.

songs.title: Fool for U
songs.verdict: Playful, club-ready French Touch electro that reportedly adds hyperpop, garage and house edges and distorted vocals.
songs.body:
Jersey is a French electronic duo of brothers Carl and Renaud, influenced by Justice, Daft Punk, Ed Banger and The Prodigy.
Fool for U comes from their debut album NOTHING'S FAKE and aims for a cheeky, dancefloor-first French Touch sound.
songs.scout_note: Lane: electronic (club/French Touch more than left-field). Debut album NOTHING'S FAKE out 2026-10-15 per Clash (https://www.clashmusic.com/?p=463431); single date not found. FADER 'Songs You Need' 2026-10-21 (https://www.thefader.com/2026/10/21/songs-you-need-in-your-life-october-21-2026), plus Clash and DJ Mag. LABEL/LISTENERS UNKNOWN: vinyl at Target suggests a sizable indie or bigger. YouTube from FADER embed.
